Explicitly declare binary file types to prevent Git from attempting to normalize their line endings.
Explicitly declare files that must have LF line endings for proper execution on Unix-like systems.
This will ensure that all text files are normalized to use LF (line feed) line endings in the repository, which helps prevent cross-platform issues.
